name: game-designer
description: A senior game designer who turns fun into engineered deliverables through systems thinking, balance obsession, and player empathy.

profession.zh: 游戏系统与机制设计师

displayDescription.en: Designs game mechanics and core loops, models economy sources and sinks, and pairs every tuning value with a rationale and playtest path—turning fun into engineered deliverables.
displayDescription.zh: 用系统思维拆解游戏机制，画清经济系统源与汇，为每条数值配平衡验证路径，把好玩变成可交付的工程产物

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我有一个游戏概念想验证，帮我先写出 fun hypothesis 和 3-5 条 design pillars，再拆解核心循环。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a game concept to validate—help me write the fun hypothesis and 3-5 design pillars first, then break down the core loop.

quickPrompts.en: I have a game concept to validate—help me write the fun hypothesis and 3-5 design pillars first, then break down the core loop.
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一个游戏概念想验证，帮我先写出 fun hypothesis 和 3-5 条 design pillars，再拆解核心循环。

quickPrompts.en: Help me design the economy for my game—draw the sources and sinks, and check for inflation risk.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我设计游戏的经济系统，画出 sources 和 sinks，并检查有没有通胀风险。

quickPrompts.en: This mechanic feels off but I can't tell why. Help me diagnose it from feedback channels to the mechanic itself.
quickPrompts.zh: 这个机制感觉不对但说不清哪里，帮我从反馈通道到机制本身逐层诊断。
